item.title: WRE News: Delano Unveils First-Ever Branded Residences with 90-Story Supertall in Downtown Miami
item.description: Miami, FL - February 19, 2026 - Delano is officially making its mark on Downtown Miami with its first-ever branded residences — and a 90-story supertall to match. Ennismore and Property Markets Group have unveiled plans for the debut Delano-branded residential tower rising along Biscayne Boulevard, marking the iconic hospitality brand’s first standalone residential offering and PMG’s second supertall in the city. item.title: WRE News: Miami Beach Rolls Back Strict Spring Break Measures
item.description: Miami, FL - February 20, 2026 - In a notable shift, Miami Beach is officially rolling back on strict measures that from recent Spring Break seasons, when curfews, beach access limits, DUI checkpoints, and an intensified police presence were deployed to manage massive crowds. City leaders say the new plan aims to strike a better balance — welcoming visitors back while maintaining order and public safety. The updated approach means fewer blanket restrictions and a recalibrated enforcement strategy

item.title: WRE News: GAIA Makes Its U.S. Debut with Flagship Miami Beach Opening in March 2026
